$schema.description: JSON Schema reference enabling editor autocomplete and validation.

project.title: Project
project.description: Flagsmith project, as its numeric ID or its name. Find the ID in the dashboard (its URL, or the JSON data view); a name is resolved via the Admin API. `flagsmith config` shows the resolved project name.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: Optional. Organisation, as its numeric ID or its name. Used by organisation-scoped commands that have no project context (e.g. creating a project). If not set, a default organisation is used. For project-scoped commands the organisation is derived from the project.

environment.title: Default environment
environment.description: A client-side environment key (recommended), or an environment name. A key is safe to commit — client-side keys are public by design — and enables flag evaluation with no Admin API credentials; a name is resolved via the Admin API and needs credentials. Server-side keys (ser.*) are secrets and are rejected here — provide those via the FLAGSMITH_ENVIRONMENT_KEY environment variable instead.

apiUrl.title: API base URL
apiUrl.description: Optional. Base URL of a self-hosted Flagsmith instance (scheme + host, without /api/v1). Omit when using Flagsmith SaaS.

sdkApiUrl.title: SDK API base URL
sdkApiUrl.description: Optional. Base URL of the SDK API used for flag evaluation. Only needed when the SDK API lives on a different host than apiUrl (e.g. when using Edge Proxy). When omitted, falls back to explicitly set apiUrl, otherwise to Flagsmith Edge API (https://edge.api.flagsmith.com).
